name: Electric Lock Rune
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-12: Snakes in the Grass
description: An invisible rune imprinted on a chest's lock releases a powerful electrical discharge.
disable: DC 20 Thievery (expert) to scratch out the rune without allowing electricity to flow, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 18) to counteract the rune

generalAbilities.name: Electrocution
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the lock directly or with a tool.

Effect The trap deals 3d12 Electricity Damage damage to the triggering creature (Basic DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw save).
